card.name: Linking words before test results
card.fires_on: Small linking words (on, to, of, that, comma) right before an expected mention of test or study results, analyses or conclusions. Seen in lab methods, assay and testing text.

modes.label: Link before results
modes.description: A preposition or conjunction that leads into 'test results' or 'results' in testing and validation text.
modes.example: minimize effects of test organism health<< on>> the reliability and comparability of test results

modes.label: Verb or phrase about accuracy
modes.description: A verb or phrase like ensure, allow or in order, setting up a note on keeping data accurate.
modes.example: for each thing in<< order>> to keep the results accurate.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words like analyses, analysis, conclusions and studies as the next word.
card.plain: It fires on small connecting words just before the text names the results or analysis of a test.
